selected_content_reviews.full_guidance:
• The relationship between the independent (predictor) and dependent (response) variables
• The significance of the slope and intercept in the regression equation
• How well the model fits the data—often assessed using measures like r².
selected_content_reviews.observation: Prompt and criteria establish predictor/continuous response, fitted relation and prediction. Slope/intercept are named without individually assessing their interpretation; r² is unassessed.
selected_content_reviews.outcome: Partial scope; new fit/parameter-interpretation practice remains needed.
